_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Per-user deadline-calendar settings page (REQ-CDC-006): category toggles (BTW/ICP/VPB filing, payment runs, opt-in AR due dates, contract deadlines) + reminder lead times. The menu leaf is merged into the existing 'Settings' group by id (mergeMenuItems in main.js). The page component (kind:page DeadlineCalendarSettings in src/registry.js) talks to the strictly current-user-scoped /api/deadline-calendar/settings endpoints.

pages.title: Deadline calendar
pages._note: Per-user settings form (category switches + per-category lead-time inputs, saved via the current-user-scoped /api/deadline-calendar/settings endpoint) — no standard index/detail/dashboard page type renders a preference form.
